Slop CRM · free, in your browser

A free HubSpot CRM alternative, in your browser

If you want a customer list and pipeline without an online account, Slop CRM runs in your browser and keeps every customer, note and follow-up on this device.

Try Slop CRM

How to do it

  1. Import your contacts into Slop Contacts as vCard or CSV; they appear in the CRM.
  2. Sort them into groups and coloured tags.
  3. Move leads along the Pipeline board.
  4. Keep dated notes and follow-up dates, and see orders and invoices per customer.

What it has: customers with several phones, e-mails and addresses, groups, tags, a four-stage pipeline, dated notes, follow-ups, and links to the orders and invoices of the Slop business apps. What it does not have: email sending or tracking, a team, forms, or marketing tools.

Your files stay on this device: Slop CRM runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Is Slop CRM made by HubSpot?

No. Slopographic is not affiliated with HubSpot. HubSpot is a trademark of its owner, and the name is used here only to describe what people search for.

Can I export my customers?

Yes. Slop Contacts exports the same records as vCard, CSV, Excel, Google CSV or Outlook CSV, and a full backup holds everything.

Is my customer data uploaded?

No. It is kept in this browser on this device and never sent to a server.
